manifesto.title: Five schools. One city. Zero chance.
manifesto.body: We pass each other every day between classes without ever talking. Atomes brings the verified students of five campus schools into one circle: no endless swiping, no fake profiles, no algorithm selling you. Just good reactions, in friendship as in love.

verify.title: Verify your school email
verify.body: A six-digit code lands in your school inbox. One address, one person: no fake profiles, and a ban stays a ban.

profile.title: Create your profile
profile.body: Your first name, a few photos, three questions that feel like you. Never your last name. And you can hide from your school, your class or specific people.

card.label: Element card
card.name: Alex
card.detail: Class of 2028 · Friends and Love mode
card.answer: A surprise gig, then pasta at 1 a.m.

chemistry.title: Let the chemistry happen
chemistry.body: Every evening at 9 p.m., the Drop offers you a small, carefully chosen selection. And once a semester, the Pact reveals your match, at the same time as the whole campus.

race.title: Which school has the best chemistry?
race.lead: The ranking uses the share of each school's headcount, not the number of sign-ups: the smallest schools stand every chance.
race.tableCaption: School race ranking, by share of each school's headcount

race.goalReached: Goal reached: see you at the launch party.
race.estimate: Estimated headcounts, to be confirmed with the schools. Refreshed every 20 seconds.
race.unavailable: The counter will be back in a moment.
race.referral: Every sign-up gets a referral link: share it in your class groups to push your school up.

pact.title: 45 questions. One match. The same night for the whole campus.
pact.body: Answer the Pact questionnaire before 7 February. On 11 February at 8 p.m., everyone discovers their most compatible person, at the same time as the whole campus. Better no match than a bad match.

safety.title: Our commitments
safety.lead: On a campus, everyone knows everyone. Atomes is designed so that your presence and your conversations stay between you and the people you choose.

verified.title: Verified or nothing
verified.body: Sign-up only with your school email. Minimum age: 18. One address, one account.

discreet.title: Discreet by default
discreet.body: First name only, neutral notifications, and the option to hide from your school, your class or specific people.

moderation.title: Human moderation
moderation.body: Blocking is instant and needs no reason. Reporting takes two taps. Every report is reviewed by a trained person, and every decision is explained.

data.title: Your data stays in Europe
data.body: Hosted in the European Union, encrypted messages, no advertising, no data resale.

who.question: Who can sign up?
who.answer: Students aged 18 and over at EPITA, ESME, Sup'Biotech, ISG and IPSA in Lyon, with their school email address.

free.question: Does it cost anything?
free.answer: No, and it never will: no subscription, no blurred likes, no paid boosts. The project is funded by local partnerships, never by your data.

friends.question: I'm mostly looking for friends, is it for me?
friends.answer: Yes. Friends mode is built in: you choose Love, Friends or both, and you can switch whenever you like.

pact.question: What is the Pact?
pact.answer: A big matching event every semester. You answer about 45 questions, and on 11 February at 8 p.m. you discover your most compatible person, at the same time as the whole campus.

discretion.question: Will my class see me?
discretion.answer: Only if you want. You can hide from your whole school, your class or specific people, and notifications stay neutral.

waitlist.question: What happens to my address on the waiting list?
waitlist.answer: It is only used to send you your referral link. It is not stored: only an encrypted fingerprint (HMAC) is kept to avoid duplicates.

when.question: When does it open?
when.answer: Profiles and the Pact questionnaire open in January, and the reveal takes place on Thursday 11 February 2027 at 8 p.m. Join the list so you don't miss anything.

team.question: Who is behind Atomes?
team.answer: Students from the campus, organised as a non-profit association. The project is independent: neither IONIS Education Group nor the schools are involved in it.

help.question: What if someone makes me uncomfortable?
help.answer: Block them: it is instant and they are not told. Report them in two taps: the moderation team handles serious cases first and can point you to your school's support service.

footer.made: Made in Lyon, at night, in the lab.
